data: Which of the following models are represented in the figure?

The figure shows three lines representing different models: BERT, BERT+Inter-LADA, and BERT+Semi-Inter-LADA. The y-axis represents loss on the development set, and the x-axis represents the number of epochs. The caption indicates that the models were trained with 5% labeled data. Therefore, the models represented in the figure are BERT, BERT+Inter-LADA, and BERT+Semi-Inter-LADA.
